description: Dam sites in the Upper Cotter valley between Bushrangers and Collins Creeks is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. In November, 1945, the Department of Works and Housing requested that a Geological Survey be made of a section of the Upper Cotter Valley in which it is proposed to construct a dam. Four possible dam sites were examined along the Upper Cotter River between Bushrangers and Collins Creeks. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU-ACT, GA Publication, Geology, Published_External, Record. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
